test_title: PYST 71: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 23 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

O. want

P. movie tonight

Q. do you

R. to watch

S. the
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (2)** i.e. **QORSP**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence logically starts with "Do you," which is correctly indicated by **part (Q).**
 
• Following this, "want" **(O)** continues the sentence, as it naturally follows "do you."
 
• The next part "to watch" **(R)** specifies the action you want to do.
 
• The part "the" **(S)** introduces the object of the sentence.
 
• Ending with "movie tonight" (P) completes the thought by specifying what is to be watched.

Therefore, the correct answer is **QORSP.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (RSPQO):** This option starts with "to watch," which does not form a complete question without context from the beginning.
 
• **Option 3 (OSQPR):** This option starts with "want," which does not form a grammatical question.
 
• **Option 4 (OSPQR):** This option starts with "want," which does not form a grammatical question.
